CommunityApplications.Profile:
Docker images for the **Plezy Watch Together relay server**.
[Plezy](https://github.com/edde746/plezy) is a cross-platform Plex, Jellyfin and Emby client. Its Watch Together feature syncs playback between viewers through a relay server, and upstream supports pointing clients at your own instead of the public one. The relay source ships in the Plezy repository but upstream publishes no image, so self-hosting it otherwise means building it by hand.
This repository rebuilds upstream's own unmodified Dockerfile on every Plezy release and publishes multi-arch images to GHCR, so the Unraid template always has a current build to pull. Images are tagged to match the Plezy release they came from, so a relay can be pinned to the client version in use.
Unofficial: not affiliated with or endorsed by the Plezy project. Container and template issues go to this repository's issue tracker.
